description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Impulse', which is a PHP class for rendering impulse charts as part of the Image_Graph library. It includes methods for drawing legend samples and outputting the plot, extending a base plot class.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Impulse
classes.description: A class for rendering impulse charts within the Image_Graph PHP library, extending the base plot class.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample line for the legend, centered between x0 and x1, from y0 to y1.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the impulse plot, handling stacking, scaling, and drawing lines for data points.
